description: Calculate what an interest rate really earns after federal tax, NIIT, state tax and inflation. Defaults match the Valudati case study: 37% federal, 3.8% NIIT, 13.3% California, 3.74% inflation (CPI-U, Nov 2026). Set state_exempt for Treasuries. Education only, not advice.

amount.description: Optional balance in USD to show dollar figures

niit_pct.description: Net investment income tax; use 0 if it does not apply

rate_pct.description: Pre-tax interest rate in percent, e.g. 4.29

name: after_tax_yield
title: After-tax and after-inflation yield
